purpose: Frozen development cluster reference for subsequent unseen comparison
centroid_definition: Arithmetic mean of saved member workflow embeddings; float32 source values accumulated in float64; centroid is not L2 normalized
normalized_centroid_definition: Separate centroid_l2_normalized field for cosine comparisons
